reviews.t: The flower looks exactly like it does online and is very pretty
reviews.x: The flower looks exactly like it does online and is very pretty. The reason I am giving it 1 star is because it lasted one night before the clip spring broke and would not clip on my second attempt to wear it.  I contacted the seller and they told me they would send me a new one, which they never did.

Beautiful!!! I am very happy with this hair flower. I love hair flowers and I have amassed quite a collection of various ones over the years. This particular one is one of the best ones I've ever found. The quality of the petals is what makes it so nice. The petals are a soft velveteen material with subtle “ridges” that make it look very lifelike. It doesn’t look cheap or “plasticky” at all like some other hair flowers I’ve seen in the past.

I ordered two hair roses one in red and the other white. Quality was ok, I thought it would be much better, the leaves on the red rose were smashed and the white rose was dirty. The packaging was very nice, and it was delivered in a timely manner.

reviews.t: I saw this and loved it, fast delivery and perfected her look
reviews.x: So my daughter was going to prom she said she wanted a classy look and she wanted a flower in her hair. I debated if we should do real but I was worried for it holding up all night! I saw this and loved it, fast delivery and perfected her look!
Easy to clip in. Holds hair in place. Does not slip out.

This flower arrived on time and it is absolutely perfect! From the size to the design and packaging, I could not have been happier with this product. I ordered two different flowers, this vibrant red and a dark red, and they arrived in a sturdy Amazon box instead of a paper or poly mailer bag. No chance of them being crushed! I was able to pull the flower directly from its packaging and clip it right into my hair in 10 seconds. No fluffing, no fussing, just easy perfection! I received a number o

reviews.t: Perfect for my hair on my wedding day
reviews.x: Perfect for my hair on my wedding day. I paired it with two of the deeper red roses and sparkle pins. If I'd make any changes. I'd have them a little smaller only because of shortness of my afro. But they still looked beautiful and natural.
This is surprisingly beautiful! Very happy with the quality, of you're thinking of purchasing it but not sure I'd go for it. I will be wearing it for my wedding and it definitely looks great.
Perfect for my 40s hairstyle and vintage dress that I'm wearing  at a wedding tonight.

reviews.t: Love it! Perfect hair accessory for pinup!
reviews.x: I bought this rose to wear in my hair for a pinup-themed event. It's is absolutely gorgeous! You won't get fraying edges with the velvet, as opposed to a silk rose. The leaves are silk, but don't show very much from the bottom of the rose. The red is a little brighter than shown in the seller's photo.  The clip holds firm in the hair, and there is a pin to use the rose as a broach.

reviews.t: Accurate size and good shaped flower
reviews.x: Good item and accurate size as said in the description. Also looks just like the photo. I ordered something this on eBay once but the size was off and the flower squished looking. This item is much much better.

reviews.t: This flower is even more beautiful than I expected
reviews.x: This flower is even more beautiful than I expected.  Well made and looks great in the hair.  My daughter wore it for a show and people thought it was real.
Beautiful and very realistic!  I actually had someone come up and smell it. :-)  I loved it and ended up buying the dark red one as well.
Didn’t work for me to put in my hair. Didn’t feel right. Clipped it to my dress and BAM loved it! Great flower! Love love love!!!
Looked great on my dress - but was a good option for my hair as well because it has both a clip & a pin.
Beautiful, very full excited to wear it for my wedding this fall!

reviews.t: It is so beautiful! Excellent quality
reviews.x: It's exactly as pictured. It is so beautiful! Excellent quality.

reviews.t: Loved on my MOH at my wedding
reviews.x: Very realistic look! Loved on my MOH at my wedding.

This was mandatory for my daughter's recital.  It's an incredibly heavy flower for the type of clip provided, so it hangs awkwardly and falls out frequently, even with normal movement.  When I pulled it out of the plastic bag provided, the bag was completely lined with red color that had come off of the flower in shipping.  The flower is still red, but it sheds.  Considering this was a TEN dollar clip, I wouldn't expect a shedding flower, big globs of glue or a giant flower that can't be support

reviews.t: just needs a larger clip for thick hair
reviews.x: The rose is beautiful and looks realistic. My only complaint is that the clip to hold it in your hair should be bigger. My hair is very thick and the small clip just wouldn't hold the rose in place securely. I was going to be wearing it as a bridesmaid so I was worried that it might fall out during the wedding. I ended up glueing a Bobby pin to the back of it to reinforce the hold.

reviews.t: Decent and cheap. Good for a low budget cosplay.
reviews.x: This was ok for the cosplay project I was working on. It did the job but not much more. When it arrived the edges of the petals were frayed and stringy. Whatever fabric was used was not of a decent quality. The clip came off the backing after a few uses but that was an easy fix with hot glue. All in all, it worked for what I needed, but I wouldn't expect much more from it.

It is wonderful and beautiful! I received so many compliments on it, and it looked like a real flower too. With a red skirt and black top, it helped give a spanish feel to my outfit.The clip held my hair back and I experienced no issues. Thank you!
Several people stopped me and asked how I could have a real rose stay in my hair and then amazed when I told them it was not real.  Plan on purchasing in a different color soon.
Look real, nice color, nice material, the leaf look cheap, the flower somewhat high, hair clip make it easy to clip on clothes but It may damage your hair.
This is so perfect - it's gorgeous and looks great in my hair. I have fine hair and the clip actually stays in - unlike many others I've tried!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the flower as beautiful, gorgeous, or realistic-looking, often exceeding expectations.
Many customers praise the quality and construction, including the velveteen petals and well-made feel.
The clip is easy to use and holds hair in place well, though one reviewer reported the clip spring breaking after one night.
Customers report fast, timely delivery and nice packaging.
A few reviewers note minor issues like a higher price, smashed leaves, or a dirty rose on arrival.
